awards.name: Abitur 1.0 (top ~1% of German Gymnasium cohort) - LK Politik, Geschichte, Englisch

rationale.intuition: Georgetown REA (restrictive but non-binding) overall EA 10.3%; intl admit 7.75% (RD). SFS (School of Foreign Service) is Georgetown's flagship and strong fit for German diplomatic/policy profile. Abitur 1.0 = top ~1% of German cohort, maps to ~4.0 unweighted in AO conversion. Georgetown is need-blind for intl — favorable. European intl penalty lighter than Asian. Industry: T20 REA strong European IR profile cluster 6-25%.

sources.name: Georgetown CDS 2024-25
sources.evidence: Overall admit 12.92%; EA 10.3% (restrictive); intl admit 7.75%. Need-blind for intl applicants.

sources.name: Georgetown SFS International Briefing 2024
sources.evidence: Abitur 1.0-1.3 accepted as top-tier credential; LK (Leistungskurs) treated as AP-equivalent. SFS prioritizes language proficiency + international experience.

sources.name: Ivy Coach European Applicants 2024
sources.evidence: German Abitur 1.0 + IR-aligned profile at Georgetown REA cluster 8-22% per published case data; SFS-specific yield-protect considerations apply.
